thread:
kai: Quick heads-up — planning to take the migration semaphore for orders.schema at 15:40 UTC (in ~25m). This will run: add column orders.v2_status, backfill status for 3 days of rows, and add FK index. Need one ops+db on standby.

deploybot: Deploybot scheduled: release/orders-migration-2026.03 queued. Estimated runtime 12–18m. Lock mode: lightweight row-level; migration tool will acquire "migration-semaphore:orders-schema".

maddy: Can we set the BACKFILL_RATE to 150/s? Last time 300 caused WAL spikes.

kai: Yes — we're setting env: BACKFILL_RATE=150 and MAX_CHUNK=500. If wal_bytes > 150MB, workers pause. See config in infra repo:
```bash
# infra/ops/migrations/orders_backfill.env
BACKFILL_RATE=150
MAX_CHUNK=500
WAL_LAG_THRESHOLD_MB=150
```

samir: Where's the rollback? Add exact command please.

kai: Rollback is idempotent script: infra/ops/migrations/rollback_orders_v2.sh
```bash
./rollback_orders_v2.sh --dry-run
# to force revert:
./rollback_orders_v2.sh --force --drain-workers
```

ananya: I'll watch replica lag and be ready to cut the semaphore if locks show >2s tail contention. I'll be on call.

ops-bot: migration-semaphore acquired by kai for orders-schema at 1766300123

jess: TY. If we hit lock waiters > 20, abort and revert feature flag immediately.

maddy: Suggest pinning app version on canary to release-2026.3 for 1 hour during rollout to avoid schema mismatch.

kai: Agreed. We'll set RELEASE_PIN=release-2026.3 on canary and prod on deploybot.

deploybot: Release pin applied to canary (release-2026.3). Canary instances: web-canary-3.

ops-bot: WAL lag watch: current replica lag 12MB -> OK. TRACES: https://internal/traces/abc123

samir: If rollback triggered, plan: 1) drain worker queue 2) run rollback script 3) unpin release 4) run smoke tests. Who will hit the rollback button?

ananya: I'll initiate rollback and coordinate with kai for smoke.

kai: Fine. Abort criteria we agreed: any p99 lock wait > 3s OR WAL lag > 400MB OR >2% error increase on write endpoints within 10m.

maddy: I'll update release notes with the schema change and post the ops playbook snippet.

deploybot: Starting migration now (step 1/4): create column orders.v2_status (non-null default handled via backfill).

ops-bot: DB logs: ALTER TABLE ... OK; rows touched 0/12,123,456; ETA ~10m

samir: Noting a short spike in CPU on db-primary; keep an eye.

ops-bot: Backfill progress: 2% — workers at target rate.

ananya: WAL lag creeping to 220MB — throttling workers to 100/s.

kai: Confirmed throttle applied.

jess: :eyes:

ops-bot: Backfill progress: 64% -> ETA 3m

deploybot: Step 3/4: create index concurrently on orders(v2_status) queued.

maddy: Concurrent index takes lower locks but watch for bloat. Post-index cleanup in 24h.

ops-bot: Migration complete — all steps done. Semaphore released by kai at 1766300380

kai: Great job team. Unpin canary after 1h and then roll main. I'll file a short postmortem if anything odd.
